name: new-task
script: (async () => { const w = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); [...document.querySelectorAll('button[role=radio]')].find((b) => b.textContent.trim().startsWith('数学推理'))?.click(); await w(200); document.getElementById('algorithm-fot')?.click(); await w(200); document.querySelector('input[aria-label=全选]')?.click(); await w(1200); document.getElementById('participants')?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' }); window.scrollBy(0, -16); await w(300); })()

script: (async () => { const w = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const d = document.querySelector('details.module'); if (d) d.open = true; await w(300); document.getElementById('settings')?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' }); window.scrollBy(0, -16); await w(300); })()

name: app-try
script: (async () => { const w = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const set = (el, v) => { const proto = el.tagName === 'TEXTAREA' ? HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype : HTMLInputElement.prototype; Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(proto, 'value').set.call(el, v); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); }; set(document.getElementById('try-question'), 'Find the number of ordered pairs of positive integers (m, n) such that m^2 n = 20^20.'); set(document.getElementById('try-answer'), '231'); await w(300); })()
